Uncharacterized; Fruit-Epidermis-specific by Visium projection (Supp Fig 14d-f); snRNA cl15 st5 0.95/0.24 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)

Glutamate dehydrogenase; RNA in situ in fruit bundles (Supp Fig 12b); snRNA cl8 st5 0.68/0.16 (SD13). Cell type within the bundle not resolved (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)

Metallothionein; in situ called vascular (Fig 3e), but snRNA cl13 Parenchyma 0.97/0.25 exceeds cl8 0.68/0.34 (SD13); authors conceded it is not pedicel-bundle specific. Use only with other vascular markers (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)
Uncharacterized; vascular by Visium projection (Supp Fig 14j-l); snRNA cl8 st5 0.17/0.002 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)

Transcription factor (unnamed); RNA in situ (Fig 3d) and FISH (rebuttal) in achene seed; first published as a pith marker and reassigned during review; snRNA cl4 st5 0.53/0.31 (SD13), low specificity (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)
SEEDSTICK MADS-box ovule/seed-coat identity (ortholog per the paper's text); Visium seed projection (Supp Fig 5b); weak in snRNA (cl4 st2 0.32/0.09) (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)
DELAY OF GERMINATION1 seed-maturation gene (ortholog per the paper's text); snRNA cl4 st5 0.21/0.04 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)

Vacuolal processing enzyme; paper calls it ALPHA-VPE (text) and GAMMA-VPE (SD5) but lists AT3G20210 = delta-VPE, the seed-coat PCD VPE in Arabidopsis; snRNA cl19 st3 0.69/0.10; Visium seed 0.69/0.07 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)

YUCCA auxin biosynthesis; ProFveYUC11::GFP-GUS throughout the endosperm after fertilization (Feng et al. 2019 J Exp Bot); enriched in snRNA Seed cl4 st5 0.13/0.02 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun). Cross-study agreement; low detection rate

Most abundant seed YUC; ProFveYUC10::GFP-GUS in the whole endosperm (weak) and fveyuc10 CRISPR lowers fruit free auxin (Feng et al. 2019 J Exp Bot). Ma 2026 says Seed-specific at st2 (Supp Fig 25), but its only DE hit is cl18 'Carpel' st5 0.25/0.009, so not raised
YUCCA auxin biosynthesis; ProFveYUC5::GFP-GUS exclusively in the chalazal endosperm st2-5 (Feng et al. 2019 J Exp Bot). Not in Ma 2026 DE tables
Tryptophan aminotransferase for auxin synthesis; ProFveTAR1::GFP-GUS almost exclusively in the endosperm st2-5 (Feng et al. 2019 J Exp Bot). Not in Ma 2026 DE tables

Type I MADS-box; transient ghost-specific (endosperm + seed coat) expression in dissected-tissue RNA-seq, and fveagl62 mutants fail to induce endosperm auxin synthesis (Guo et al. 2022 Nat Commun). Not cell-resolved; not in Ma 2026 DE tables
1-cysteine peroxiredoxin (aleurone/endosperm in Arabidopsis; ortholog per the paper's text); snRNA cl4 st5 0.67/0.16 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)

YUCCA auxin biosynthesis; ProFveYUC4::GFP-GUS predominantly in the embryo st2-5 (Feng et al. 2019 J Exp Bot). In Ma 2026 its only DE hit is cl18 'Carpel' st5 0.25/0.003, suggesting cl18 holds seed cells at st5

Uncharacterized; style by Visium projection (Supp Fig 13j-l); snRNA cl9 st2 0.37/0.02 (Ma et al. 2026 Nat Commun)
